Loads or downloads genesis.bin, verifies hashes, and initializes the account database.

# Purpose
This file implements the `genesi` tile, which loads a Solana `genesis.bin` file and publishes the result to the rest of the system. It supports two paths: read a local genesis file from disk, or download `genesis.tar.bz2` from configured gossip entrypoints when no local file exists and download is allowed. In both cases, the code decodes the genesis data, computes the genesis hash, checks the cluster type against known mainnet, testnet, and devnet hashes, and verifies any configured expected genesis hash. When the node boots with no gossip entrypoints, it also computes the shred version from the genesis hash and checks it against the configured value.

The file also initializes the account database from the genesis account list when the node is bootstrapping, and it publishes output through the `stem` tile framework. For local genesis, it sends the genesis hash or a bootstrap completion message. For downloaded genesis, it decompresses the tarball with bzip2, writes the file to disk, renames the partial file into place, and publishes the hash. The file defines the tile lifecycle hooks, file descriptor and seccomp policy setup, scratch memory layout, and the `fd_tile_genesi` run tile descriptor used by the runtime.
